title: Anthropic 发布 Fable / Mythos 新版：支持超千个智能体协同，多项硬核性能大升级
content:
As the highly anticipated U.S. stock market listing schedule draws increasingly closer, leading artificial intelligence company Anthropic has recently officially unveiled new versions of its flagship AI models Mythos and Fable. The move is intended to further solidify and consolidate its leading position in the global AI development field.
Fable 5.2 Gets a Comprehensive Upgrade: Tackling Highly Difficult Software Engineering and Coordinating More Than 1,000 Agents
As one of the core highlights of this update, Fable 5.2, scheduled for official release on Monday, has achieved a qualitative leap in its ability to handle complex tasks.
According to the official introduction, the model can not only handle more difficult software engineering development work, but also perform more complex tasks closely related to hardware, such as controlling robots, while smoothly handling long-running projects. Particularly noteworthy is that Fable 5.2 demonstrates powerful swarm orchestration capabilities, able to coordinate more than 1,000 AI agents working together at the same time. In terms of performance and cost, while maintaining faster operation than the previous version, the model also achieves a lower overall usage price.
Mythos 5.2 Focuses on Vertical Domains: Safety Safeguard Adjustments, Targeted Rollout to Specific Organizations
Unlike Fable, which emphasizes comprehensive engineering capabilities, the same series' Mythos 5.2 has undergone specialized optimization in cutting-edge professional fields such as cybersecurity and life sciences.
In order to better serve professional technical research, the model has streamlined and adjusted safety safeguards related to cybersecurity and life sciences. Anthropic clearly stated that Mythos 5.2 will be rolled out in a targeted manner to certain qualified specific organizations through the previously announced professional verification program.
Overall, these two comprehensively accelerated next-generation models not only demonstrate Anthropic's continuous breakthroughs in underlying technology research and development, but will also provide solid product support for its upcoming capital market moves.

report.summary: Anthropic 发布 Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2，可协同超千个智能体
report.background: 这条消息发布之际，Anthropic 正临近赴美上市，需要用产品进展支撑资本市场叙事。行业层面，2025 年 AI 竞争正从「单个模型更聪明」转向「多智能体编排 + 长周期自主执行」：谁能调度成百上千个 Agent 完成端到端工程任务，谁就更接近真正的生产力工具。同时，网络安全、生命科学等高价值垂直领域对模型能力与安全护栏的平衡提出更高要求。Anthropic 此前推出的专业验证计划，正是为「定向开放高风险能力」铺路，Mythos 5.2 便是这一思路的落地。
key_points: Fable 5.2 可同时协调超过 1000 个 AI 智能体协同工作，从「单兵作战」升级为「群体调度」。
除复杂软件工程外，该模型还能处理机器人控制等硬件相关任务，并能胜任长时间运行的项目。
在性能提升的同时，运行速度比上一版更快，整体使用价格更低，性价比同步改善。
Mythos 5.2 针对网络安全、生命科学等前沿专业领域做了专门优化，并精简了相关安全护栏。
Mythos 5.2 不面向公众开放，需通过专业验证计划定向提供给符合资质的特定机构。
report.impact: 对行业而言，多智能体协同规模成为新竞争维度，模型厂商的比拼从参数转向编排与工程落地能力。对开发者来说，千级 Agent 调度意味着可以构建更复杂的自动化流水线，但也需要新的可观测性、成本控制与失败恢复手段。对普通用户，短期感知有限，但长周期任务的自动化程度会逐步提升；同时「定向开放 + 资质验证」的模式，预示着强能力模型将分层供给，普通用户与专业机构之间的能力差距可能拉大。
report.tools: 想跟进可关注多智能体编排框架：AutoGen、CrewAI、LangGraph、OpenAI Swarm，以及 Anthropic 的 Claude Agent SDK 与 MCP（模型上下文协议）；做长任务编排时建议配合 LangSmith 等可观测性与追踪工具。
